detectors.label: Standard — YOLO11n (10 MB)
detectors.source: Ultralytics YOLO11n pretrained on COCO 2017 (class 9 'traffic light'); not fine-tuned

eval.dataset: DriveU traffic-light test split (129 real driving frames, Germany) — evaluation only, never trained on
eval.note: Precision is a lower bound: the dataset labels only ego-relevant lights, so many detections counted as false positives are real, unlabelled traffic lights.

detectors.label: High accuracy — YOLO11s (36 MB, desktop)
detectors.source: Ultralytics YOLO11s pretrained on COCO 2017 (class 9 'traffic light'); not fine-tuned

eval.dataset: DriveU traffic-light test split (129 real driving frames) — evaluation only

state_classifier.trained_on: Udacity/MIT traffic-light crops (MIT licence, 1,187 train) + synthetic UNKNOWN (unlit, glare, blur, background); trained 2026-11-22

eval_in_domain.dataset: held-out test split, 447 crops (297 real + 150 synthetic unknown)

eval_cross_dataset.dataset: DriveU state crops, 2,494 real crops from German cities — never trained on

state_classifier.licence: Model weights: © Infinity Techub Intelligence; training code MIT-compatible

limitations: Not yet trained or validated on Ghanaian signals; fine-tune with locally labelled data before operational reliance (see ml/README.md).
Distant signals (< 25 px tall) are often missed; the result is then 'no signal / UNKNOWN', never a guess.
Directional arrows and pedestrian aspects are classified by colour only; arrow direction is not yet recognised.
Advisory only — never a substitute for the physical signal, road rules or the driver's own observation.
